'''Bryson''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Major/Legends|major]] of the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Bryson worked with [[Vector Hyllus]] and [[Anora (Human)|Anora]] at one point in his career.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bryson first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', but the mission that he would have introduced on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] was cut from the game before release. Bryson would have sent players to speak with Captain [[Guyvar]], who they needed to convince to send one of his [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] workers to the Diplomatic Service in order to impress visiting Chevin diplomats.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />
